cheats.name: Speed up (relax frame limiter)
cheats.description: Raises the ~4 fps cap. The game paces itself with a frame limiter that targets a 500 ms period (about 4 fps); this lowers the target to 100 ms (about 20 fps) so the game runs roughly 5x faster and smoother.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: frame-limiter re-arm: replace `ldr r3,[r4,#0x7c]` (load the 500 ms target period) with `movs r3,#100`, so timeout = 100 - elapsed instead of 500 - elapsed. Tune the target by changing the first byte: 0x64=100ms/~20fps, 0xa6=166ms/~12fps, 0xfa=250ms/~8fps.
